task: leftovers_23sep pod3b: POD3 item 3b. Twin the Qwen3-Omni readout-direction cosine 0.0051 with the real lm_head rows, rerun the probe refit, log both, explain 0.7864 vs 0.8307.
values_file: pod3b_values.tsv (121 rows; 0 disagree with the verifier at 4 dp; every row that has a published or Mac value matches it at 4 dp)

headline.cosine_all: 0.0051 (0.005109), verifier 0.005109; Mac check from the 10 lm_head rows 0.005109. Conflict -0.0067, agreement 0.0086. Random floor 0.0177 [0.0008, 0.0498].
headline.refit: Linux sklearn 1.9.1 refit 0.8307 [0.7833, 0.8741], equal to POD3's saved OOF to 6e-8 per clip. With the Mac's folds the same Linux fit gives 0.7864 [0.7335, 0.8359].
headline.gap_cause: GroupKFold fold assignment. scikit-learn 1.9.0 made GroupKFold sort group sizes with a stable sort (PR 28464, v1.9 changelog; 1.6.1, 1.7.2 and 1.8.0 sources use the default sort, 1.9.0 and 1.9.1 use kind='stable'). The Mac has 1.7.2, the pods 1.9.1. 228 speakers share 8 distinct clip counts (112 have 1 clip), so the tie order decides the split: all 228 speakers get different fold-mates. Linux fit on Mac folds = 0.7864 and Mac fit on Linux folds = 0.8307, so the solver and platform add nothing at 4 dp.
headline.what_0_8307_is: one draw. Over 200 partitions of the same greedy rule that differ only in tie order: mean 0.8033, sd 0.0122, 2.5 to 97.5 percent 0.7786 to 0.8244, range 0.7713 to 0.8414. 2 of 200 reach 0.8307; 17 of 200 are at or below 0.7864. Cosine stays in [0.0023, 0.0090], never outside the random floor.
headline.paper_line_149: 'removing the readout direction leaves their probes at 0.81 and 0.83': on the POD3 split Qwen3-Omni gives 0.8305 (train z) / 0.8276 (held-out z). Averaged over the 200 splits it is 0.8061 / 0.7998, and the probe itself averages 0.8033, so removing d still changes nothing (mean change -0.0029 / +0.0034). The cosine clause (0.005, at the random floor) holds on every split.

definitions.states: q3o_pitt_states.npz key ans, [:, -1, :] (final thinker stage at the first answer position), float32 cast to float64; 468 clips, 228 speakers, arms from the clip name prefix (equals the manifest 'set' column on 468/468)
definitions.direction_d: softmax(X W^T) over the full 152064 vocabulary; wy = mean over clips of the 5 Yes-token probabilities, wn the same for the 5 No tokens, each renormalised to sum 1; d = W_yes^T wy - W_no^T wn, unit norm. Yes ids 7414 9454 9693 9834 14004; No ids 902 2152 2308 2753 8996
definitions.lm_head_as_pod3_used: rescore_probe.py line 22 saved net.lm_head.weight.float() as float16; reproduced by W.astype(np.float16). 49826 rows / 62019 entries change under that rounding; the cosine changes by under 1e-9.
definitions.probe: GroupKFold(5) by speaker; per fold StandardScaler on the training fold, LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, class_weight='balanced'); OOF probability pooled
definitions.cosine: w = mean over folds of coef/scale, unit norm; cosine = w . d. Random floor: 2000 unit Gaussian directions from default_rng(0), mean |w . r| and 2.5/97.5 percentiles
definitions.auc_without_d: per fold w_perp = w - (w.d/d.d) d on standardised features; trainz standardises held-out scores with the training fold mean/std (as shipped); foldz standardises within the held-out fold (canonical, Q3O_direction_FIXED.json)
definitions.auc: rank formula with averaged ties (primary) and scipy mannwhitneyu U/(n1 n0) (verifier)
definitions.bootstrap: 2000 draws, fresh numpy default_rng(0) per cell, idx = rng.choice(N, size=N, replace=True) over the sorted unique speaker ids, 2.5/97.5 percentiles; same idx for every quantity (paired). Primary intervals recomputed on the Mac from the pods' per-clip columns by scripts/build_pod3b_values.py; verifier intervals computed on lo-pod3b-2.
definitions.partitions: sklearn's greedy rule (largest speaker first into the lightest fold) with ties broken by default_rng(seed).permutation, seeds 0..199
